text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente conquered the Japan Cup. 
Everyone acknowledges that she is Japan's 
strongest. Countless feelings and hopes 
are directed toward her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Duramente announces she will carry those 
feelings on her shoulders. Shouldering 
everything, she heads out to the world—to 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Her challenge alongside her had only just 
begun.

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Postscript
text_block_list.text:
—I asked Trainer to write down the path 
I've walked in this notebook.

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Postscript
text_block_list.text:
To the comrades of our bloodline. May the 
tracks left by my hooves serve as 
nourishment for your future.
